title: Process Art — selected demonstrations
review: Selected after contact-sheet and individual-image inspection from 24 second-round candidates; earlier trial presets were also rendered. Selected tissue boundaries were refined analytically and rechecked in the final export.
selection_basis: Contour rhythm, readable negative space, red/black hierarchy, and variety of composition. No numerical beauty ranking.

items.label: Dendritic ledger I
items.reason: Asymmetric relief with the clearest central branching and several quiet contour basins.

items.label: Dendritic ledger II
items.reason: A more open drainage pattern and a different rhythm of ridges; retains the model's visible D8 direction bias.

items.label: Fault archive I
items.reason: Readable marker-bed offsets and a broad, calm field of bent layers.

items.label: Fault archive II
items.reason: A stronger lower fold and a visibly different cut through the two faults.

items.label: Vascular palimpsest - leaf
items.reason: Pointed silhouette, strong stem, chemical detail and an empty seal aperture.

items.label: Vascular palimpsest - annulus
items.reason: Radial red growth reads clearly against winding black chemical contours; smooth analytic edges replace pixel-stepped trial boundaries.

items.label: The return engine
items.reason: Dense woven perimeter with several distinct pale openings rather than a solid central knot.

items.label: Recurrence loom
items.reason: Sparse textile-like matrix provides contrast to the circular return engine and makes its repeated diagonals readable.
